projects.name: Automated Detection and Classification of Solar System Planets
projects.summary: Bachelor's Internship Project at Azad University, North Tehran Branch (2020-2021). Designed a computer vision pipeline for detecting and classifying planets in astronomical imagery from NASA and ESA archives. Applied Gaussian/median filtering, histogram equalization, CLAHE, background subtraction, Canny edge detection, and OpenCV contour analysis. Extracted morphological, photometric, color-histogram, and GLCM texture features, then evaluated SVM and KNN classifiers for multi-class planetary identification.
